template.name: Button--YDF-React
template.value:
<Button
 
  label="$LABEL$"
  HTML_Type={ Button.HTML_Types.$HTML_TYPE$ }
  accessibilityGuidance={ accessibilityGuidance }
  
  { /* === Links ==================================================================================================== */ }
  route={ Routing.Top.URI_PATH } { /* For vue-router routes */ }
  linkRenderer={ linkRenderer } { /* Consider specifying `Button.internalLinkRenderer` instead. */ }
  externalURI="https://frontend.yamato-daiwa.com/" { /* For external URIs */ }
  mustOpenLinkInNewTab={ true } { /* false by default */ }
  mustRequestNotFollowLinkForCrawlingToSearchEngine={ true } { /* Recommended for external links. false by default */ }
  
  { /* === States =================================================================================================== */ }
  disabled={ true } { /* false by default */ }
  toggled={ true } { /* The default is `false`. Consider the checkbox instead if you need this option. */ }
  
  { /* === Theming ================================================================================================== */ }
  theme={ Button.Themes.regular }$END$ { /* TODO Remove if theme is only one, default or common */ }
  areThemesCSS_ClassesCommon={ true } { /* TODO Remove if false or has been set to `true` globally */ }
  geometricVariation={ Button.DecorativeVariations.$GEOMETRIC_VARIATION$ } { /* TODO Remove if the geometric variation is `regular` (default) */ }
  { /* TODO Leave only desired ones */ }
  geometricModifiers={
    [
      Button.GeometricModifiers.pillShape,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.squareShape,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.squareShapeUnlessOverflowed,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.singleLine,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.noLeftBorderAndRoundings,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.noRightBorderAndRoundings,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.noTopBorderAndRoundings,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.noBottomBorderAndRoundings,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.noRoundings,
      Button.GeometricModifiers.horizontallyShrinkable
    ]
  }
  decorativeVariation={ Button.DecorativeVariations.$DECORATIVE_VARIATION$ } { /* The default is `Button__YDF.DecorativeVariations.regular` */ }
  { /* TODO Leave only desired ones */ }
  decorativeModifiers={
    [ 
      Button.DecorativeModifiers.bordersDisguising,\
      Button.DecorativeModifiers.noBackground,\
      Button.DecorativeModifiers.noBackgroundInDefaultState\
    ]
  }


  { /* === SCG Icons ================================================================================================ */ }
  prependedSVG_Icon={ HeartIcon__Filled }
  prependedSVG_Icon={ HeartIcon__Filled }
  loneSVG_Icon={ HeartIcon__Filled }
  SVG_IconCSS_Classes={ [ "MyIcon" ] }

  { /* === Logic ==================================================================================================== */ }
  onClickEventHandler={ (): void => { console.log("Click"); } }

  { /* === Other ==================================================================================================== */ }
  className="Card-Button"

>
